purpose: Recomposed for the hub card image frame, with inset title safe margins.

prompts.name: breadline
prompts.prompt: Regenerate the supplied title card into a NEW 5:4 landscape composition, output 1280 x 1024 pixels. The reference image is STYLE AND PALETTE reference, not a layout to crop. Recompose the geometry and typography for the much squarer 5:4 frame. Full bleed artwork, no border or mockup. Preserve the reference's dark background, clean flat geometric right-angle ribbons, square spirals, selective gradients, bold white grotesk typography. Keep ALL text within central 70% of image width, minimum 15% left AND right safe margins, minimum 15% top and bottom margins; title visually centered horizontally and located around 60% height. Pattern can bleed off edges, letters must never touch edges. Title sized to comfortably fit, not oversized. Only text is exact hub name, no HYPE endorsement logo, no handles, no additional words. Exact title 'Breadline' on one line. Warm coral and peach interwoven angular ribbons, lavender and mint accents on very dark teal. Output aspect 5:4.
